extraction.Name: Grace F. Herley
extraction.Cancelled: The patent has not been cancelled that I have any knowledge of.
extraction.Refused/Protested: I received and accepted the said patent without protest
extraction.Recorded patent: It was recorded by my husband, or by an attorney representing us. It was, however, recorded with my knowledge and consent.
extraction.Buyer: not stated; purchaser assumed and agreed to pay the first mortgage of about $1500.00; first mortgage was subsequently foreclosed and the land sold
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: The first mortgage was subsequently foreclosed and the land sold, and our second mortgage was rendered valueless.
extraction.Occupation/Income: not dependent upon anyone except my husband and my own efforts for support
extraction.NOTES: Land covered by the patent was mortgaged for $1500.00 and subsequently sold along with other lands owned by her husband and other parties; she and other parties took a second mortgage to secure the balance of payments; she did not make application to have the patent issued; patent came through the mail in regular course of mail, not receipted for; she considers the price received was a fair price; neither government, state nor county has contributed anything toward her support; physical condition is reasonably good; financial condition is not luxurious; affidavit sworn at Pendleton, Umatilla County, Oregon, November 24, 1928.
